attack.name: Dust-Choked Charge

pattern.chargeDesc: Straight-line demolition through a wall of its own dust. Tramples, never turns.

attack.telegraph: It drops its head and paws the earth — once, twice — and the dust comes up in a wall. Tusks down. It is not going around you.

attacks.name: Dust-Choked Charge

pattern.chargeDesc: Straight-line demolition through a wall of its own dust. Tramples, never turns.

attacks.telegraph: It drops its head and paws the earth — once, twice — and the dust comes up in a wall. Tusks down. It is not going around you.

attacks.name: Tusk Rake
attacks.telegraph: It swings its whole head sideways, tusks sweeping like scythes. The warts on its face are armor; the tusks are the argument.

attacks.name: Retreat
attacks.telegraph: It stops, sides heaving, dust settling off its back. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, tusks still facing you.

codexStages.observed: Warthog. The System watched it graze on its knees and decided the meek part was a lie. It charges through its own dust wall — tusks, hooves, and bad intentions. It cannot turn mid-charge.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Dust-Choked Charge (heavy, telegraphed, a wall of blinding dust ahead of it), Tusk Rake (close range, sideways sweep), Retreat (below 25% hp). It never goes around — step OFF the lane and hold your breath until the dust settles. Meat: excellent pork. The tusks make fine awls.
codexStages.unknown: Something heavy moved in the grass. Then the dust stood up and walked toward you.

counter.hint: It never turns. The charge is a straight-line promise, and the dust is just weather.
counter.reveal: When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike.
counter.trick: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath

curious: It snorts, considering you. Deciding if you're worth the effort.
fearful: It backs off, snorting — firelight in its eyes. It doesn't like this.
warn: It drops its head. Paws the earth. Dust rises. This is the warning. There won't be another.

edible.note: Pork is pork. Smoke it; it keeps for weeks. The tusks make excellent awls.

name: Dustboar
unknown: something heavy rooting in the grass, dust rising for no reason
vibe: a living dust storm with tusks — territorial, impatient, unimpressed by you
weaknesses: dodge the charge - it ends winded, flanks soft; STRIKE then
it never goes around — position accordingly
the dust blinds it too; it charges where you were

attack.name: Sunflash Lunge
attack.telegraph: It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds —

attacks.name: Sunflash Lunge
attacks.telegraph: It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds — then it launches, blind-fast, straight at where you were standing.

attacks.name: Tail Sweep
attacks.telegraph: The thick tail lifts off the ground, swaying once — then sweeps like a felled tree. A monitor's tail is a battering ram with scales.

attacks.name: Retreat
attacks.telegraph: The mirror-scales dull. It stops arching, hisses once, and slides backward into the grass — done being looked at.

codexStages.observed: Nile monitor. The System grew mirror-scales along its back and taught it to aim the sun. It blinds you with reflected light, then lunges while you can't see. The tail is a separate weapon — thick as your leg.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Sunflash Lunge (blinding telegraph, then a fast lunge at your last position), Tail Sweep (close range, knockdown), Retreat (below 25% hp). The glare needs the sun behind IT — fight from its shadow side, or make it face away from the sun. Never stand where you were standing.
codexStages.unknown: A flash of light from the grass, like a mirror catching the sun. Then nothing. Then the flash again, closer.

counter.hint: The glare needs the sun behind it. Its shadow side is blind.
counter.reveal: When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales.

curious: It tastes the air, forked tongue flickering. Deciding if you're food or furniture.
fearful: The mirror-scales dull to grey. It wants the deep grass now.
warn: It arches its back to the sun. The light off its scales hurts to look at. Move.
wary: It circles, keeping the sun at its back. It knows what its weapon needs.

edible.note: Tough reptile meat — stew it long. The mirror-scales flake off; they're pretty and useless.

name: Sunback
unknown: a monitor lizard the size of a canoe, light sliding wrong off its back
vibe: a patient mirror with teeth — it lets the sun do the aiming
weaknesses: the glare needs the sun behind it — fight from the shadow side
after the lunge it recharges; STRIKE then
it lunges where you WERE — never stand still
